headline: Asset Arena Wire Launches as a Press Release Wire Built for Sports Business
subheadline: New platform opens a limited Founding Member program for teams, leagues, sports tech companies, investors and facilities operators.
body: Asset Arena today announced the launch of Asset Arena Wire, a press release distribution service focused entirely on the business of sports. The wire gives teams, leagues, sports tech startups, funds, facilities operators and youth sports organizations one place to publish announcements to the investors, operators, media and partners who follow the industry.

General newswires treat sports as one category among hundreds. Asset Arena Wire is built around the sports business community itself, with categories covering investment and capital, sports tech, teams and leagues, facilities and venues, NIL and athletes, youth sports, and media and sponsorship.

"Every week I see sports companies announce funding rounds, partnerships and launches that never reach the people who would act on them," said David Lasday, publisher of Asset Arena. "Asset Arena Wire puts those announcements in front of a network that is actually looking for them."

Every release is reviewed before it goes live and receives a permanent hosted page, placement on the Asset Arena Wire homepage and category pages, and inclusion in the public RSS feed. Organizations pay only after their release is approved.

Single releases are $199. A limited number of Founding Member slots are available at $1,200 per year for organizations that expect to announce news regularly. Submissions are open now at the Asset Arena Wire website.

about.name: Asset Arena
about.text: Asset Arena is the newsletter where sports, capital and infrastructure intersect, published by sports business connector and advisor David Lasday. It covers sports tech, investment, facilities, NIL and youth sports for a global audience of investors, operators and athletes.
